Title: Successfully register a new user with valid details
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /addingUser with the form parameters supplied in testData.

Test Data: uname=John Doe&uemail=john.doe@example.com&upassword=password123&unumber=9876543210
Expected Result: HTTP 302 Found response redirecting to /admin/services, confirming user creation

Title: Successfully add a new product to the catalog
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /addingProduct with the product details in testData.

Test Data: pname=Margherita Pizza&pprice=12.99&pdescription=Classic cheese and tomato pizza
Expected Result: HTTP 302 Found response redirecting to /admin/services, indicating product was successfully added

Title: Successfully search for an existing product by name
Preconditions: A product named 'Margherita Pizza' exists in the catalog
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /product/search with query parameter productName set as in testData.

Test Data: productName=Margherita Pizza
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response returning the BuyProduct view containing the product details for 'Margherita Pizza'

Title: Successfully create a new administrator account
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /addingAdmin with the administrator details in testData.

Test Data: adminName=System Admin&adminEmail=admin@example.com&adminPassword=SecurePass123&adminNumber=5551234567
Expected Result: HTTP 302 Found response redirecting to /admin/services, confirming administrator record creation

Title: Admin login fails with invalid credentials
Preconditions: The application is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /adminLogin with email 'wrongadmin@example.com' and password 'wrongpassword'.

Test Data: email=wrongadmin@example.com&password=wrongpassword
Expected Result: The request returns HTTP status 200 rendering the 'Login' page with error model attribute 'error' set to 'Invalid email or password'.

Title: User login fails with invalid email or password
Preconditions: The application is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /userlogin with userEmail 'unknownuser@example.com' and userPassword 'invalidpass'.

Test Data: userEmail=unknownuser@example.com&userPassword=invalidpass
Expected Result: The request returns HTTP status 200 rendering the 'Login' page with error model attribute 'error2' set to 'Invalid email or password'.

Title: Search for a non-existent product name
Preconditions: The product catalog does not contain an item named 'NonExistentProduct123'.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /product/search with query parameter productName set to 'NonExistentProduct123'.

Test Data: productName=NonExistentProduct123
Expected Result: The request returns HTTP status 200 rendering the 'BuyProduct' view with model message 'SORRY...!  Product Unavailable'.
